about: Runtime code of the contracts whose code differs between the a2b4412 build (v3 as first deployed, e.g. the v3-test record) and this one: forge's deployedBytecode and immutableReferences, from `git archive a2b4412 contracts` built with contracts/foundry.toml (solc 0.8.24, evm cancun, optimizer 200 runs; forge 1.7.1) and contracts/lib with every submodule initialised, openzeppelin's own included (their remappings are in the metadata hash). The front door and staker differ since the launch-cadence build; the adapters and the vault since the pre-audit build. CascadeTwapOracle is byte-identical in both builds.
